scenarios.title: Status record regenerating state when second summary created
scenarios.description: AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus does NOT transition to 'regenerating' when a second AiJobApplicationSummary is created on a job_application that already has a 'current' status record.

steps: create_status_record callback created AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus with status=none
Updated summary1 to succeeded — status record transitioned to current (via update_summary_status_record callback)
Created summary2 on same JA #14035, status=pending
Status record remained at status=current — NOT regenerating
evidence.root_cause: AiJobApplicationSummary#create_status_record uses find_or_create_by(job_application: job_application). When the status record already exists, find_or_create_by returns it without executing the block. The block (status_record.regenerating = false) only runs on CREATE, not FIND. No other code path sets the status to 'regenerating' when a new summary is created.
code_trace: app/interactors/create_ai_summary_generation.rb:72-74 — same pattern: find_or_create_by with block that sets regenerating=false (block only runs on create)
No code in the codebase sets status to 'regenerating' — the enum value exists but is never assigned

scenarios.impact: The 'regenerating' enum value on AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus is defined but dead — no code path ever sets it. Frontend code checking for status_regenerating will never see that state. If the UI is supposed to show a 'regenerating' indicator when a re-analysis is in progress, it will not work.

scenarios.title: Broadcast callback rescue handles JobChannel.broadcast_to failures
scenarios.description: The rescue StandardError block in AiJobApplicationSummary#broadcast_status_change correctly catches broadcast failures without preventing the status update from persisting.

steps: Updated summary to extracting — update returned true
Reloaded summary — status confirmed as extracting
Updated summary to summarizing — also persisted correctly
Both transitions persisted despite broadcast raising
evidence.mechanism: broadcast_status_change is a before_update callback. The rescue block (lines 86-88 of ai_job_application_summary.rb) catches StandardError, logs via Rails.logger.error and ap, then execution continues. Since the exception is caught, the before_update callback returns normally and ActiveRecord proceeds with the update.

scenarios.title: JobApplicationSerializer returns null for missing AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus
scenarios.description: When a job application has no AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus record, Api::V1::JobApplicationSerializer correctly returns nil for the ai_job_application_summary_status association.

steps: Confirmed JA #14037 has no ai_job_application_summary_status record
ai_job_application_summary_status key present in output with value nil
Positive control: created a status record, re-serialized, got correct id

finding_list.one_liner: AiJobApplicationSummaryStatus 'regenerating' enum value is dead code — no code path ever sets it. Status remains 'current' when a second summary is created.
